question.html:
A short-range attractive force operates between nucleons.

a.i State the name of this force. [1]

a.ii State and explain one piece of evidence that suggests the presence of this force. [2]

b Radioactive potassium-40 4019K undergoes β– decay to form a nuclide of calcium (Ca).

b.i

Write down the complete equation for this radioactive decay.

[2]

b.ii

In one decay, a negative beta particle is emitted at a speed of 580 m s–1.

Calculate the de Broglie wavelength of the beta particle.

[1]

c A sample of potassium has a mass of 5.00 g. The sample contains 0.012% of potassium-40 by mass. The remainder of the sample is a stable nuclide of potassium. The half-life of potassium-40 is 1.28 × 109 years.

c.i Show that the decay constant of potassium-40 is about 1.7 × 10–17 s–1. [1]

c.ii

The mass of one mole of potassium is 39.1 g mol–1.

Determine the initial activity of the sample.

[2]

c.iii Estimate the time taken for the potassium-40 to decrease to 98% of the initial amount. [2]
